title: 3D Baseball: The Majors
native_title: ３Ｄベースボール ～ザ・メジャー～
overview:
Ballparks and players in full 3D polygons! Plus, it uses motion capture technology that takes in the movements of real people.

Players' movements and quirks are reproduced with polygon action.

700 players registered in the Majors for the '96 season appear with real names and photos! And of course, all based on real game data.

球場・選手が3Dフルポリゴン！
さらに実際の人間の動きをとり込むモーションキャプチャー技術を使用。

選手の動きやクセもポリゴンアクションで再現。

メジャー96年度登録選手700名が実名・写真付きで登場！もちろん実戦データに準拠。
